problem.subtitle: It's always the same story: graduating knowing how to solve quadratic equations, but not knowing how a credit card, budget, or investment works.
problem.card1_text: Kids learn about money from TikTok or friends, filling themselves with dangerous myths.
problem.card2_text: Money is the #1 cause of stress in adults. Don't let it be your children's.
problem.card3_text: Traditional courses are boring PDFs that kids hate to read.
problem.card4_text: Trial and error is the most expensive way to learn finance in the real world.

solution.subtitle: We use "Simulation-Based Learning". Learn finances by playing with interactive simulators and exciting challenges.
solution.benefit1: Learn by making virtual mistakes (not real ones)
solution.benefit2: Discover the power of saving with visual tools and achievable goals
solution.benefit3: Educational content designed specifically for each age and level

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: It's designed primarily for children and teenagers aged 5 to 17. However, many adults have told us they also learn a lot from the basics.
faq.q2: Is it safe for my children?
faq.a2: Absolutely. There's no open chat with strangers, no external advertising, and all data is encrypted.
faq.a3: We're currently in a Free Open Beta. You can register and use all features at no cost. In the future we'll have premium plans, but there will always be a free tier.
faq.q4: Do I need to supervise my child while they play?
faq.a4: It's not necessary, the platform is self-guided. However, we have a "Parent Dashboard" where you can see their progress and we give you tips to discuss what they learned.
